description: Add one or more products to the cart in a single call (put a whole request's items in one call). For several of the SAME item use `quantity` (e.g. "2 Chili Boxes" → quantity: 2). For DIFFERENT products use `items` (an array of { productId, quantity?, optionValueIds? }), each with its own `quantity`. For a single product, pass `productId`/`quantity`/`optionValueIds` directly. product_id comes from search_merchant_products/get_product_details; optionValueIds are addon/size value ids from the product's options. One merchant per cart.

items.description: Add multiple items in one call.

language.description: Language for item names (en, ar, kr, bd).

optionValueIds.description: Option value ids for the single product.

productId.description: Single product id to add (when not using `items`).

name: add_to_cart

items.description: Cart line items (line_id, product_id, name, quantity, prices, options).

title: Add to cart
